result.headline: THREAT IDENTIFIED
result.what_happened: Someone guessed Anna's password, then signed in from another country at 2 AM on a device nobody knows.
result.what_is_it: Credential abuse: attackers guess, steal or reuse passwords to log in as a real user. The login looks normal, so it is easy to miss.
